description: This file defines an interface for a service that calculates the pre-mature amount for deposit accounts in the savings portfolio. It contains a method 'calculatePreMatureAmount' which takes an account ID, a query object, and a deposit account type to return deposit account data related to the calculation.

classes.name: DepositAccountPreMatureCalculationPlatformService
classes.description: An interface that declares a method for calculating the pre-mature amount of deposit accounts related to savings.

methods.name: calculatePreMatureAmount
methods.description: Calculates the pre-mature amount for a deposit account given an account ID, query parameters, and deposit account type.
